summary: Bold menu names, buttons and fields in GUI procedures, and use the RST code-block directive for commands.
questions: How should I format menu names and buttons in docs?
How do I show a command snippet in RST?

answer_card.title: Highlight menu items and commands
answer_card.answer_md:
- Bold GUI elements: "On the **File** menu, click **Open**."
- Use RST code blocks for commands:
```rst
.. code-block:: bash

  ssh my_vyos_user@vyos.example.net
```
